description: Build a blocked batched FP32 Cholesky path for n=512 through n=2048, separating diagonal-panel factorization from parallel triangular solve and rank-k update tiles while exploiting concurrency across matrices.

Right-looking FP32 blocked Cholesky for n=512..2048 with 256-wide panels, batched triangular solves, and in-place batched rank-k trailing updates; validation passed; geomean 2204.401 us vs parent 2153.690 us.

Dispatch 256-panel blocked schedule only for high-batch n=512 (batch>=64) and n=1024 (batch>=16), retaining cuSOLVER for low-batch and n=2048; validation passed; geomean 2110.496 us vs parent 2153.690 us.
Use 128-wide panels for the high-batch blocked paths; validation passed; n=512 high-batch 4886.467 us and n=1024 high-batch 3321.330 us; full geomean 2127.096 us.

Left-looking 256-panel FP32 schedule computes diagonal and column updates from accumulated factors, eliminating full trailing-matrix updates and final tril pass; validation passed; high-batch n=512 4507.046 us, n=1024 2829.787 us; geomean 2125.342 us.

Extend left-looking blocked path to high-batch n=2048 and use 512-wide panels for n=1024/2048; validation passed; n=1024 high-batch 3043.763 us, n=2048 high-batch 5780.112 us, full geomean 2134.549 us.

Write panel copies, Cholesky factors, and triangular solves directly into noncontiguous result views to remove intermediate tensors; validation and benchmark correctness passed; n=512 high-batch 4785.754 us, n=1024 high-batch 2904.706 us; geomean 2147.072 us.
Attempted four-way CUDA-stream batch sharding of the blocked schedule; build passed but the mandatory leaderboard portability gate rejected explicit stream references before remote validation.

Fuse each left-looking diagonal and below-panel update into one contiguous full-panel batched GEMM before factorization and solve; validation passed; n=512 high-batch 4572.739 us, n=1024 high-batch 2826.878 us; full geomean 2101.586 us.

Compile the fused blocked schedule with torch.compile reduce-overhead; correctness passed, but targeted means were noisy with long outliers (n=512 4683.015 us, n=1024 3048.109 us); full geomean 2107.111 us.

Use packed contiguous panel workspaces with in-place Cholesky and triangular-solve outputs; correctness passed. This Modal sample ran every unchanged shape roughly 1.6x slower as well; targeted n=512/n=1024 cells were 7993.207/4845.039 us and full geomean 3535.529 us.

Restore fused contiguous blocked buffers and restrict dispatch to high-batch n=512 to expose library n=1024 timing; validation passed; blocked n=512 was 4578.857 us, library n=1024 high-batch 2897.252 us; full geomean 2183.691 us.

Swap dispatch to fused blocked n=1024 high-batch only, exposing library n=512; validation passed. Library n=512 high-batch measured 3804.645 us while blocked n=1024 measured 2823.665 us; full geomean 2055.654 us.

Overwrite the contiguous full-panel RHS during each triangular solve, removing the separate solved tensor while retaining n=1024-only dispatch; validation passed; targeted cell 2886.370 us and full geomean 2073.356 us.
Orient the below-panel triangular solve as row-major right-sided X*L^T=A21; validation passed; targeted n=1024 high-batch cell 2899.941 us and full geomean 2077.323 us.

Best full-grid score was 2055.654 us at a4b557037bcfc8e5846d5d6e23cbe923faf26e79, 4.55% lower latency than the 2153.690 us baseline. That commit uses a fused left-looking FP32 256-panel schedule only for n=1024 batch>=16; its targeted batch=60 cell measured 2823.665 us. Measurements across edits: initial right-looking all-size path 2204.401; high-batch 256-panel dispatch 2110.496; 128 panels 2127.096; left-looking separate updates 2125.342; 512 panels plus n=2048 2134.549 (n=2048 cell 5780.112); strided in-place outputs 2147.072; explicit streams failed the leaderboard gate and were logged; fused panel update 2101.586; compiled fused path 2107.111 with outliers; packed in-place sample 3535.529 while all unchanged cells were uniformly slow; n=512-only dispatch 2183.691 with blocked n=512 4578.857; n=1024-only dispatch 2055.654 while library n=512 measured 3804.645; in-place left solve 2073.356; right-sided solve 2077.323. Keep the work going: open directions include a fused-schedule panel-width sweep between 128 and 512, combining this schedule with a custom high-concurrency panel factor from the small-matrix brief, fusing panel update and triangular solve in a portable CUDA extension, and exploring a more GEMM-heavy supernodal/recursive n=2048 schedule without explicit streams. Rebenchmark or leaderboard-submit a4b5570 because unaffected cuSOLVER cells varied materially across Modal samples. Local profiling was waived by the run configuration.

Build a blocked batched FP32 Cholesky path for n=512 through n=2048, separating diagonal-panel factorization from parallel triangular solve and rank-k update tiles while exploiting concurrency across matrices.

Forward-restore the a4b5570 fused left-looking FP32 256-panel n=1024-only behavior from current HEAD and remeasure Modal variance; validation passed; target cell 2828.429 us vs prior 2823.665 us, full geomean 2068.411 us vs prior 2055.654 us.
Structured fused-width sweep: use 128-wide panels for the n=1024 high-batch left-looking schedule; validation passed; target cell 2757.868 us vs 2828.429 us at 256 width, full geomean 2071.430 us.
Structured fused-width sweep: use 192-wide panels for n=1024 high-batch; validation passed; target cell 2834.157 us, full geomean 2065.865 us.
Structured fused-width sweep: use 384-wide panels for n=1024 high-batch; validation passed; target cell 2939.458 us, full geomean 2073.434 us.
Structured fused-width sweep endpoint: use 512-wide panels for n=1024 high-batch; validation passed; target cell 3068.951 us with outliers, full geomean 2117.176 us.

Integrate same-run brief-0 portable C++20 one-block FP32 128x128 factorizer as each blocked diagonal panel, retaining fused batched updates and solves; validation and benchmark correctness passed. This Modal sample ran all unchanged shapes about 1.65x slower; target cell 5010.278 us and full geomean 3513.454 us.

Extend the portable 128-panel kernel so one CTA factors its shared tile and then solves every below-panel row before one result copy; correctness passed, but target cell measured 17830.323 us and full geomean 2374.255 us.

Replace the one-CTA custom solve with a second portable kernel using 4-thread row teams, 30 rows per shared-memory block, and roughly 1800 CTAs for the first n=1024 panel; correctness passed; target fell from 17830.323 to 4865.788 us, full geomean 2145.173 us.
Widened custom n=1024 block-128 below-panel triangular-solve row teams from 4 to 8 threads; validation passed, target B60 n1024 3634.200 us, aggregate 2093.317 us.
Extended custom block-128 fused left-looking panel/update schedule to B>=4 n2048; validation passed, B8 n2048 improved from 4882.631 to 4426.167 us while aggregate reached 2087.489 us.
Combined library block-256 panels at B60 n1024 with custom block-128 fused panels at B8 n2048; validation passed, targets 2831.979 and 4433.488 us, new branch aggregate best 2055.336 us.

Doubled custom panel solve row teams to 16 threads and 512-thread CTAs; validation passed, B8 n2048 improved from 4433.488 to 4284.782 us, though unrelated sample variance raised aggregate to 2076.830 us.

Replaced only the n2048 custom factor/solve with library Cholesky and triangular solve while retaining block-128 fused GEMM updates; validation passed but B8 n2048 regressed to 5214.491 us and aggregate to 2152.073 us.

Kept the custom block-128 diagonal factor but replaced the below-panel solve with triangular inversion plus batched GEMM; validation and benchmark correctness passed, but B8 n2048 regressed to 7673.328 us and aggregate to 2235.528 us.

Restored custom 16-thread below-panel solves and packed 31 rows per CTA, the maximum below 48 KiB shared memory; validation passed, B8 n2048 improved to 4272.802 us and aggregate set a new branch best of 2052.181 us.

Composed the fastest measured block-128 library schedule at B60 n1024 with the custom block-128 factor/31-row solve at B8 n2048; validation passed, targets reached 2708.076 and 4254.483 us, aggregate new branch best 2039.747 us.

Best commit 28e4b410ed24d163cb87ae03f0489381765e0be0, metric linalg/cholesky_py=2039.746780 us versus 2153.690 us baseline (1.0559x). It uses portable block-128 left-looking library panels for B>=16 n1024 and a custom one-CTA FP32 diagonal factor plus 16-thread/31-row parallel triangular-solve CTAs with fused left-looking GEMM updates for B>=4 n2048; all other shapes retain torch.linalg.cholesky_ex. Full validation, input-variation guard, benchmark correctness, and kernelguard passed; local profiling was explicitly waived by layout. Measured targets: B60 n1024 2708.076 us, B8 n2048 4254.483 us. Width sweep covered 128/192/256/384/512; inverse-GEMM and library-only n2048 panels regressed. Open branches include fusing factor writeback with solve-factor staging, reducing repeated packed-factor loads across solve CTAs, and exploring an opt-in larger-shared-memory block-256 custom panel.
